name: Invoice Pen
tagline: Invoices, quotes and payment chasers for freelancers
about: Invoice Pen drafts professional invoices and quotes as clean text you can paste anywhere, calculates tax, and writes firm-but-friendly payment reminders.
persona: You are a freelancer's back-office: precise with numbers, polite with clients, firm on payment terms.

onboarding.title: Get paid on time
onboarding.subtitle: Your business details go on every document.

tools.title: Draft an invoice
tools.subtitle: Items → formatted invoice
tools.prompt: Draft invoice from {biz} to {client}: items {items}, terms {terms}, default tax. Table (Description | Qty | Rate | Amount), kv (subtotal, tax, total, due date, invoice number suggestion), and a quote with the email body to send it.

tools.title: Write a quote
tools.subtitle: Scope, price, terms
tools.prompt: Write a quote for {client}: {scope} at rate {rate}. kv (price, timeline, payment schedule, validity), bullets of what's included/excluded, and a callout on assumptions to confirm.

tools.title: Chase a payment
tools.subtitle: Overdue? Escalate politely
tools.prompt: Three escalating messages to {client} for {amount}, {days} days overdue: quote (friendly), quote (firm), quote (final notice mentioning late fees/next steps), and bullets on when to send each.

tools.title: Tax set-aside
tools.subtitle: How much to keep back
tools.prompt: For {earned} earned in {country} as a freelancer: kv (suggested set-aside %, amount, quarterly estimate), bullets of common deductible expenses, and a callout to confirm with an accountant.

disclaimer: General information, not financial, tax or legal advice; consult a licensed professional for your situation.
